integrity: Self-contained analytic proof of exact trace-norm perturbation and Fourier Hessian; rational certificate checks selected identities but is not a substitute for infinite-dimensional proof. No independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-rank, fixed-area, smooth small radial endpoint perturbations only; the remainder is not uniform in parameters, and no global uniqueness or entire high-mode strictness theorem is claimed.
title: Exact angular Hessian of Gaussian Ky Fan concentration around disks
